20from n6705_ui.models import ChannelMeasurement, ChannelTotals
21
22
23@dataclass(slots=True)
24class _AccumulatorState:
25 last_timestamp: datetime | None = None
26 totals: ChannelTotals = field(default_factory=ChannelTotals)
27
28
29class ConsumptionLogger:
30 def __init__(self) -> None:
31 self._file_handle = None
32 self._writer: csv.DictWriter | None = None
33 self._path: Path | None = None
34 self._states: dict[int, _AccumulatorState] = {}
35
36 @property
37 def is_running(self) -> bool:
38 return self._file_handle is not None and self._writer is not None
39
40 @property
41 def path(self) -> Path | None:
42 return self._path
43
44 def start(self, path: str | Path) -> None:
45 if self.is_running:
46 raise RuntimeError("Ya hay un logging activo")
47
48 output_path = Path(path).expanduser().resolve()
49 output_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
50
51 self._file_handle = output_path.open("w", newline="", encoding="utf-8")
52 self._writer = csv.DictWriter(
53 self._file_handle,
54 fieldnames=[
55 "timestamp_iso",
56 "channel",
57 "voltage_v",
58 "current_a",
59 "power_w",
60 "charge_ah",
61 "energy_wh",
62 ],
63 )
64 self._writer.writeheader()
65 self._file_handle.flush()
66 self._states.clear()
67 self._path = output_path
68
69 def stop(self) -> None:
70 if self._file_handle is not None:
71 self._file_handle.close()
72 self._file_handle = None
73 self._writer = None
74
75 def register(self, sample: ChannelMeasurement) -> ChannelTotals:
76 if not self.is_running or self._writer is None or self._file_handle is None:
77 raise RuntimeError("El logger no está activo")
78
79 state = self._states.setdefault(sample.channel, _AccumulatorState())
80 if state.last_timestamp is not None:
81 delta_seconds = (sample.timestamp - state.last_timestamp).total_seconds()
82 if delta_seconds > 0:
83 delta_hours = delta_seconds / 3600.0
84 state.totals.energy_wh += sample.power_w * delta_hours
85 state.totals.charge_ah += sample.current_a * delta_hours
86
87 state.last_timestamp = sample.timestamp
88
89 self._writer.writerow(
90 {
91 "timestamp_iso": sample.timestamp.isoformat(timespec="milliseconds"),
92 "channel": sample.channel,
93 "voltage_v": f"{sample.voltage_v:.6f}",
94 "current_a": f"{sample.current_a:.6f}",
95 "power_w": f"{sample.power_w:.6f}",
96 "charge_ah": f"{state.totals.charge_ah:.9f}",
97 "energy_wh": f"{state.totals.energy_wh:.9f}",
98 }
99 )
100 self._file_handle.flush()
101 return ChannelTotals(
102 charge_ah=state.totals.charge_ah,
103 energy_wh=state.totals.energy_wh,
104 )
105
106 def totals_for_channel(self, channel: int) -> ChannelTotals:
107 state = self._states.get(channel)
108 if state is None:
109 return ChannelTotals()
110 return ChannelTotals(
111 charge_ah=state.totals.charge_ah,
112 energy_wh=state.totals.energy_wh,
113 )
